caption: The drawing contains three main objects, primarily depicted in shades of brass and gold with some black details. On the left side of the image, there is a brass stove or burner with a wide, circular base and tiered structure, including a black horizontal handle. Above the base, supported by three metal arms, is a flat ring with an open center. Below this burner, there is a small container with a black handle extending to the right, holding a lidded cup or spoon on top. To the right, there is a brass kettle with a bulbous, rounded body, a short spout, a domed lid topped with a small black knob, and a wire handle with a large, ribbed black grip in the center. The objects are arranged on a plain, light beige background, and the illustration employs shading to describe their metallic surfaces and dimensional forms.
title: Burner and Kettle
